Loader file /app/frontend/src/data/tensesFeelsLoader.ts code-reviewed: exports loadTensesFeels(locale, forceRefresh) + invalidateTensesFeelsCache(), calls /content-library/render/tenses_feels via api util with 5s timeout, falls back to STATIC_FALLBACK on empty blocks or any exception, module-scoped CACHE keyed by locale, partitions emotions by tense/category — implementation matches Phase B spec.
action_items: None — all 7 Phase B acceptance items pass. /tools/tenses-feels backend wiring is verified end-to-end (render endpoint + write-through). Loader file is correctly structured; visual/UI smoke test of the page deferred per scope (backend only).

Optional minor: iter134 test still hardcodes build_version=2026.06.17.004. Consider updating it to match the latest build or making it a regex like ^2026\. — left as-is since version-stamp checks are intentionally tied to a specific iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/content_library.py unchanged from iter134 — render endpoint /render/{module} is stateless (queries Mongo each call), so PUT→render write-through works without an explicit cache-invalidation hook. Good for correctness; consider adding a thin TTL cache later if QPS grows.

Loader (tensesFeelsLoader.ts) caches module-scoped per locale; on empty blocks it returns static fallback WITHOUT caching (correct — allows later admin seed to be picked up on next mount). On exception it falls back to static and also does NOT cache (same intent).

Loader.blockToEmotion() reads tense/polarity/category/color/narrative_paraphrase/power_statement/instruction_for_user/resolution_quote/healing_feeling from fields.* — perfectly matched to render endpoint shape; defensive defaults (e.g. tense='present', color='#5B7CFA') prevent runtime crashes if a CMS row is partially populated.

PUT endpoint replaces the entire fields dict if 'fields' present in body — callers must read-modify-write to avoid wiping other fields (the test correctly does this). Worth a comment in the route's docstring.

Render endpoint does not currently send Cache-Control headers — that's fine because admin edits become visible on next page mount (loader cache is module-scoped, cleared on reload). Mentioned in agent_to_agent_context_note.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. The 12 default tenses_feels blocks from iter134 are reused. Test PUTs new power_statement on 'clinging' block and restores the original value in pytest teardown — no permanent data change. Each run bumps the 'clinging' block version by +2 (PUT + restore).
